en: Color aerial-style view over a leafy residential hillside with many red-tile-roofed houses in the foreground and mid‑century apartment blocks behind them. In the middle distance stands a prominent church or cathedral with two tall square towers and a long nave, set within a dense historic town that spreads out across a flat plain to the horizon. The image has the look of a mid‑ to late‑20th‑century tourist postcard, but no visible printed text or caption appears on the image side.
